manufacturer.name: Ramset
manufacturer.note: US vehicular gate operator manufacturer. The documents print www.ramsetinc.com on their own covers, which is what the website is recorded from; every PDF found is served from ramsetstore.com, a Ramset-branded store. Same call as BFT's store domain - a brand in a domain is not a manufacturer's own host - so those stay third-party and supportUrl is null. Its manuals state the UL325 gate class each operator is for, and that classing is kept in the model names because fitting the wrong class to a site is a safety matter, not a cataloguing one.
